chapter: Out-of-town work, Bourbon Street and recordings
title: Los Angeles trip with Octave Crosby
summary: His only out-of-town trip was five or six weeks in Los Angeles with Octave Crosby; he names the band.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Did you ever leave town with a band?
One time I went with Octave Crosby. I went to California. We worked out there for about five or six weeks. I went with him. That's the only time I ever went out of town with him.
We went to California and played. Now what year it was in right offhand.
I mean what part of California?
Los Angeles. We went to Los Angeles. We used to play at the, what's the name of this club now? It was in Hollywood on the Audenmore and...
Well that would be in the magazine. Yeah, yeah. I'm sure it's in Downbeat.
And you went out there, let's see. It was Octave's band. You remember who was with you?

Yeah, it was. Yeah, yeah. Alvin Alcon, Boyd Banks, Octave Crosby, Jimmy Davis. Well Nelson was supposed to make the trip but his wife was sick during the time he didn't go. So, the wife followed out there by the name of Cajun. He used him on the travel. Oh Cajun? Yeah, Cajun. He worked with us.
